title: Prayer times
description: View today’s Fajr, Zuhr, Maghreb, sunrise and sunset. Read current times on the page; never guess them.

title: Open event booking form
description: Browse the public calendar and submit an event booking. Guest contact verification and approval apply.

title: MWA programmes
description: Find MWA programmes in the community calendar. Check the page for current dates.

title: Open Niaz sponsorship form
description: Offer one-time or permanent sponsorship or ask the coordinator to allocate it. Public offers require approval. Sponsor a majlis or event. User chooses the programme/date in the form; never invent an event selection.

title: Open Niaz donation form
description: Donate money to the Niaz Fund. Opens the donation form with Niaz selected. User then chooses general Niaz or a specific event and enters details. This differs from offering sponsorship.

title: Support MWA | Donate
description: Choose one-off, recurring or both. Donation checkout is currently sandbox; do not claim real payment or tax deductibility.

title: Community services
description: Find community support, counselling, cemetery services and religious guidance contacts.

title: MWA Saturday School
description: Find Saturday School information and enquiries. For MWA Tutoring use the tutoring destination.

title: Resources & documents
description: Find the Constitution, Will Form, Code of Conduct and governance documents. Do not claim to have read documents.

title: MWA Gallery
description: Browse the gallery.

title: Contact MWA
description: Send an enquiry to the approved admin team.

title: Membership enquiries
description: Contact MWA for public membership information. No access to member accounts or records.

title: Community registrations
description: Browse available public registration forms.

title: Key Islamic dates
description: View key Islamic dates from the shared calendar.

title: MWA home
description: Return to the first website view.

title: Colours, dark mode & text size
description: Open Appearance to choose a colour palette, light/dark/system mode and supported text size.

title: YouTube & community updates
description: Watch recent MWA videos within the website, use fullscreen or open YouTube. See the panel for latest posts.

title: Counselling
description: Find community counselling contacts.

title: Community support
description: Find help and community assistance.

title: Cemetery services
description: Find cemetery service guidance and contacts.

title: Resident Aalim
description: Contact MWA for religious guidance; the assistant does not issue rulings.

title: MWA Tutoring
description: Open the MWA Tutoring panel directly for tutoring information and enquiries. Separate from Saturday School.

title: Volunteer with MWA
description: Contact MWA about public volunteering opportunities.

title: MWA Constitution
description: Open Resources and choose MWA Constitution. The assistant does not read or interpret the document contents.

title: Will Form
description: Open Resources and choose Will Form. The assistant does not read or interpret the document contents.

title: Code of Conduct for Members
description: Open Resources and choose Code of Conduct for Members. The assistant does not read or interpret the document contents.

title: MWAYG Governance Framework
description: Open Resources and choose MWAYG Governance Framework. The assistant does not read or interpret the document contents.

title: Open General Donation form
description: Open the donation form with General Donation selected. User enters their own amount and required options. Checkout remains sandbox.

title: Open 313 Contribution form
description: Open the donation form with 313 Contribution selected. User enters their own amount and required options. Checkout remains sandbox.

title: Open Youth Fund form
description: Open the donation form with Youth Fund selected. User enters their own amount and required options. Checkout remains sandbox.

title: Open Khums Contribution form
description: Open the donation form with Khums Contribution selected. User enters their own amount and required options. Checkout remains sandbox.

title: Open Donation for MWA School form
description: Open the donation form with Donation for MWA School selected. User enters their own amount and required options. Checkout remains sandbox.

title: Open Fitra form
description: Open the donation form with Fitra selected. User enters their own amount and required options. Checkout remains sandbox.

title: Set up recurring donations
description: Choose recurring-only or one-off plus recurring, then choose amount, frequency and first date. The assistant never opts the user into recurring payments.
